name: CdSe zinc-blende bulk reference
modelType: Constructed periodic reference geometry from published lattice parameter and zinc-blende basis
caption: Illustrative zinc-blende CdSe lattice; not a measured quantum-dot atom arrangement.

latticeParameterSource.citation: N. Samarth et al., Growth of cubic (zinc blende) CdSe by molecular beam epitaxy, Applied Physics Letters 54 (1989), 2680–2682
latticeParameterSource.note: 6.077 angstrom was measured for CdSe epitaxial layers; this prototype uses it as a bulk-scale lattice reference, not as a measured value for the chosen 3 nm quantum dots.

renderingNotes: Fractional coordinates multiply by a=6.077 to obtain Cartesian angstrom coordinates.
Nearest Cd-Se distance is sqrt(3)*a/4, approximately 2.6314 angstrom.
A 3 nm spherical crop uses radius 15 angstrom and is illustrative; stoichiometry and dangling bonds at the crop are not a physical surface model.
Do not label surface ligands, defects, strain, reconstructions or electronic wavefunctions as measured by this geometry.
